title: 履歷與自我介紹
description: 撰寫履歷與職場自我介紹

sentences.en: I have over ten years of experience in project management.
sentences.zh: 我有超過十年的專案管理經驗。

sentences.en: I was responsible for leading a team of fifteen engineers.
sentences.zh: 我負責帶領一個十五人的工程師團隊。

sentences.en: I'm proficient in Python, Java, and SQL.
sentences.zh: 我精通 Python、Java 和 SQL。

sentences.en: I hold a master's degree in computer science.
sentences.zh: 我擁有電腦科學碩士學位。

sentences.en: My key achievement was increasing sales revenue by 30%.
sentences.zh: 我的主要成就是將銷售收入提高了 30%。

sentences.en: I managed a budget of over two million dollars.
sentences.zh: 我管理過超過兩百萬美元的預算。

sentences.en: I specialize in digital marketing and brand strategy.
sentences.zh: 我專精於數位行銷和品牌策略。

sentences.en: I successfully delivered multiple projects on time and within budget.
sentences.zh: 我成功地在時間和預算內交付了多個專案。

sentences.en: I'm a results-driven professional with a strong analytical background.
sentences.zh: 我是一個以結果為導向、具有強大分析能力的專業人士。

sentences.en: I reduced operational costs by 20% through process optimization.
sentences.zh: 我透過流程優化降低了 20% 的營運成本。

sentences.en: I have extensive experience in client relationship management.
sentences.zh: 我在客戶關係管理方面有豐富的經驗。

sentences.en: I'm certified in PMP and Agile Scrum.
sentences.zh: 我擁有 PMP 和敏捷 Scrum 認證。

sentences.en: I developed and implemented a new onboarding process for new hires.
sentences.zh: 我開發並實施了新員工入職流程。

sentences.en: My background includes both technical and business roles.
sentences.zh: 我的背景涵蓋技術和商業職位。

sentences.en: I coordinated cross-functional teams to launch new products.
sentences.zh: 我協調跨部門團隊推出新產品。

sentences.en: I'm skilled in data analysis and visualization tools.
sentences.zh: 我擅長數據分析和視覺化工具。

sentences.en: I graduated from National Taiwan University with a degree in business administration.
sentences.zh: 我畢業於國立台灣大學商學系。

sentences.en: I have a proven track record of exceeding targets.
sentences.zh: 我有超越目標的良好紀錄。

sentences.en: I'm fluent in English, Mandarin, and Japanese.
sentences.zh: 我精通英語、中文和日語。

sentences.en: I trained and mentored junior team members.
sentences.zh: 我培訓並指導初級團隊成員。

sentences.en: I streamlined the reporting process, saving ten hours per week.
sentences.zh: 我簡化了報告流程，每週節省十小時。

sentences.en: I built strong partnerships with key stakeholders.
sentences.zh: 我與主要利害關係人建立了穩固的合作關係。

sentences.en: I'm detail-oriented with excellent organizational skills.
sentences.zh: 我注重細節，具備出色的組織能力。

sentences.en: I contributed to a 40% improvement in customer satisfaction scores.
sentences.zh: 我為客戶滿意度提升 40% 做出了貢獻。

sentences.en: I oversaw daily operations of a department with fifty employees.
sentences.zh: 我負責監督一個五十人部門的日常運作。

sentences.en: I initiated and led the company's digital transformation project.
sentences.zh: 我發起並主導了公司的數位轉型專案。

sentences.en: I have hands-on experience with cloud computing platforms.
sentences.zh: 我有雲端運算平台的實務經驗。

sentences.en: I'm seeking a senior-level position where I can leverage my expertise.
sentences.zh: 我正在尋找一個能發揮我專業能力的高階職位。

sentences.en: I'm a self-motivated professional who thrives under pressure.
sentences.zh: 我是一個自我驅動、能在壓力下表現出色的專業人士。

sentences.en: References are available upon request.
sentences.zh: 推薦人資訊可依需求提供。
